tools.name: company_lookup
tools.description: Basic register (ARES) lookup: name, legal form, registered address, NACE, data-box, VAT DIČ. Input: IČO (8 digits) or DIČ (CZ+10).

tools.name: check_vat
tools.description: Plátce-DPH status from the ARES RZP record, cross-checked against the ARES DPH source flag. RZP is a HISTORICAL register (records can stop updating in 2016), so a positive here is not proof of current plátcost — the result carries registerState + caution when the two disagree. For a legally binding

tools.name: entity_status
tools.description: KYC-style snapshot: active/cancelled, which registers the entity appears in (VR, RZP, IR insolvency, NRPZS, RCNS, SZR...), plus an insolvency presence flag (IR). Insolvency is presence-only — case detail needs ISIR.

tools.name: search_company
tools.description: Company-name search in ARES (prefix match, case-insensitive; no wildcards). Returns IČOs + names + addresses for further lookups.

tools.name: validate_cz
tools.description: Checksum/format validation: IČO (mod-11), DIČ (CZ+IČO or birth number), IBAN (mod-97, CZ-specific), variable symbol. Pure local, no network.

tools.name: address_check
tools.description: Free-text Czech address -> RÚIAN-standardized (full KOD ADM, codes for obec/část/ulice, correct PSC).
